# The Frugal Crafter Blog

> A creative hub for budget-friendly craft projects, watercolor tutorials, and art instruction by artist Lindsay Weirich.

The Frugal Crafter Blog features hands-on painting tutorials, DIY craft projects, and online art classes taught by Lindsay Weirich. The site emphasizes accessible, affordable approaches to watercolor painting, gouache techniques, and creative upcycling projects, with an active community engagement through weekly Saturday chats and live paint-along sessions.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Art classes
- Gouache techniques
- Still-life tutorials
- Plein air painting
- DIY crafts
- Art supplies
- Beginner-friendly projects
- Lindsay Weirich
- Live paint-alongs
- Craft upcycling
- Watercolor techniques
- Product recommendations
- Online courses
- Community engagement

## Core Pages

- [The Frugal Crafter Blog](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com): Homepage featuring craft projects, watercolor tutorials, and art supplies.
- [My Crafty Resume](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/about): Artist bio of Lindsay Weirich with teaching experience and published works.
- [Classes!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2016-classes): Watercolor workshops and art classes by Lindsay Weirich at local venues.

## Painting Tutorials

- [Let's Paint Pears!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/17/lets-paint-pears): Watercolor still-life painting tutorial for pears using Arrtx supplies.
- [Summer Slices! Let's paint watermelon in gouache](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/02/summer-slices-lets-paint-watermelon-in-gouache): Gouache watermelon painting tutorial with time-lapse video demonstration.
- [Paint a Sweet Baby Lamb in Watercolor Live 12 pm ET 2/25/26](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/02/24/paint-a-sweet-baby-lamb-in-watercolor-live-12-pm-et-2-25-26): Live Whimsy Wednesday watercolor paint-along for March calendar page.

## DIY & Craft Projects

- [DIY Color Wheel Stools!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/02/23/diy-color-wheel-stools): DIY furniture upcycling tutorial for painting color wheel design on stools.

## Blog & Community

- [My YouTube 16th Anniversary & New Studio Tour!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/04/my-youtube-16th-anniversary-new-studio-tour): YouTube anniversary celebration with new art studio tour and setup.
- [40% off classes through tomorrow!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/16/40-off-classes-through-tomorrow): Limited-time class sale promotion with coupon code LUCKY40.
- [Sat Chat & 40% Off Class Sale!](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/14/sat-chat-40-off-class-sale): Weekly Saturday chat and St. Patrick's Day class sale announcement.
- [Sat Chat (A day late)](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/03/01/sat-chat-a-day-late-4): Weekly Saturday chat covering gouache, gel prints, and collage techniques.
- [I've Been Thinking About Painting Outside in Springtime…](https://thefrugalcrafter.wordpress.com/2026/02/27/im-been-thinking-about-painting-outside-in-springtime): Plein air painting review of Lightwish travel watercolor box.
